messages.text: I applied for a refund on my seat cushion while I was still within the deadline, but the staff member rejected it. Surely that first request keeps my refund window open?

messages.text:
A rejected proposal does **not** keep the refund window open. The exception for an earlier in-time proposal does not apply if staff rejected it, so a new request must still be within 30 days of delivery (refund-policy/v2/window).

Your seat cushion was delivered on October 9, 2026, and the recorded proposal was created on November 2, 2026. Based on those dates, the 30-day window had already passed. I can’t submit a new refund request for it under the policy.
